title: 橡树资本马克斯：乐观主导市场，估值已偏高？
speaker: Howard Marks

segments.en: Well, look, I am what's called the value investor, not with the capital V, but a small V.
segments.zh: 你看，我算是所谓的价值型配置者，不是大写V的那种，而是小写v。

segments.en: And that means our approach is to figure out the intrinsic value of an asset
segments.zh: 这意味着我们的方法是弄清一项资产的内在价值，

segments.en: and see if we can buy it at a fair price relative to that value.
segments.zh: 看看能否以相对于该价值的合理价格买入。

segments.en: The challenge today is that, in my opinion, since roughly October the 1st of 22,
segments.zh: 今天的挑战在于，在我看来，自2022年10月1日前后以来，

segments.en: I believe that the markets have been generally ruled by optimists.
segments.zh: 我认为市场总体上一直被乐观者主导。

segments.en: And the S&P has more than doubled in that period. It's been a very strong period.
segments.zh: 标普在此期间上涨超过一倍，是一段非常强劲的时期。

segments.en: And I think that you have to recognize that when the optimist rule prices tend to be high relative to intrinsic value,
segments.zh: 我认为你必须认识到，当乐观者主导时，价格往往相对于内在价值偏高，

segments.en: which means that it's a time for a little bit of caution. It's not the worst thing I've ever seen,
segments.zh: 这意味着现在需要一点谨慎。这不是我见过的最糟糕的情况，

segments.en: but I do think it's important to note that the optimists have been in control.
segments.zh: 但我确实认为，重要的是要指出乐观者一直占据主导。
